quote.text: None of these things are foretold to me; but either to my paltry body, or property, or reputation, or children, or wife. But to me all omens are lucky, if I will. For whichever of these things happens, it is in my control to derive advantage from it.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Just as we cannot predict every event in life, so too is child-rearing filled with unexpected challenges and joys. Embrace each moment with purpose and teach your children to find wisdom even in uncertain circumstances.
    • Recognize that every experience with your children—whether pleasant or painful—is an opportunity to impart resilience and virtue, much like turning obstacles into tools for growth.
  • Leadership
    • In leadership, one must accept that unforeseen events will always occur; be they setbacks or successes. Use each development as a chance to strengthen your practice of self-discipline and to recalibrate your strategy.
    • A leader sees every sign as a possibility to learn and grow. By choosing to extract advantages from all circumstances, they transform challenges into stepping stones toward a more effective and empathetic style of governance.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, unpredictability is inherent; market trends, customer needs, and technological innovations often arise unexpectedly. Accept these uncertainties as signals for innovation rather than hindrances.
    • Just as Epictetus teaches that omens are lucky when we choose to see them as opportunities, a product manager can reframe each challenge as a chance to iterate, improve, and ultimately deliver greater value to users.
